nom: Murad Cellular Hydration Barrier Repair Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin in winter reports the serum was hydrating without adding oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing flaky or textured dry skin worsened by winter, report increased hydration, softness and less flaking, with a few noting the texture is thin and lightweight rather than rich.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, some leaning dry or sensitive, report more hydration, less winter dryness and reduced redness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, eczema, or reactive/reactive-to-retinol skin, report calming of irritation and redness with no new irritation, though one dislikes the scent.
segments.mature: Reviewers who identify as mature (40s+) report improved firmness, reduced fine lines, and a more radiant look.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report reduced fine lines, firmer and plumper-looking skin, and one attributes early fine-line appearance to dehydration that improved once hydration was addressed.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report significant, often fast-acting relief from dryness and dehydration, describing softer, plumper, less flaky skin, particularly in winter; one reviewer felt the effect was moderate ('good but not great') rather than dramatic.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visible reduction in redness, including winter-related redness and redness from sensitivity/rosacea/eczema; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers repairing a compromised or damaged barrier (from retinol use, over-exfoliation, or dryness) report the serum calmed irritation and helped restore the barrier, with several citing use alongside retinol or actives as protective.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports a reduction in the appearance of enlarged pores and small red spots after a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with ongoing acne reports soothing and calming without irritation; another reports a breakout cleared up quickly during use, and one reviewer with cystic acne found it supportive for barrier healing; no reviewer reports the serum causing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum did not feel oily or heavy despite being very hydrating.

aspects.libelle: Small bottle size for the price
Layers well under makeup and moisturizer

extraits.titre: Not game changing but still a great option!
extraits.texte: I usually love any Murad product that I try. I didn't notice a huge difference right away. I didn't really enjoy the scent either. After using it for about a week, I started to notice that my dry skin was a bit moisturized. The product was a bit thin but that did make for it to easily massage into my skin.

I have incredibly sensitive skin - this is the best serum i have found that does not cause irritation at all! It feels like a drink of water on the skin - actually soaks into the skin (instead if sitting on top!) and you can truly feel the hydration. 10/10!

extraits.titre: Perfect For Dry, Sensitive, and Mature Skin
extraits.texte: Thanks to Murad and Influenster for sending me this free product in exchange for my honest review. This Murad Cellular Hydration Repair Serum it's absolutely awesome! I love that it glides on smoothly. It's not greasy and has a slight skin care scent. I can't believe how hydrating and moisturizing this serum was by itself without adding any other products. I have noticed that it has helped hydrate my skin during these cold winter months when my skin would normally be very dry. Since I am 48 years old, I truly believe this is a wonderful product for sensitive and mature skin.

extraits.titre: Helps repair a damaged skin barrier
extraits.texte: I had a stress induced cystic acne flare up and am trying to heal my skin focusing on my skin barrier. I use Korean and French products and found this Murad Cellular Hydration Repair Serum to work as well as the pricier ones. It absorbs well and leaves my skin feeling silky and ready for moisturizing and makeup. A slight earthy scent that fades quickly. I recommend for anyone working on healing their skin barrier.

I received this product gifted by Murad. I absolutely adore this serum! It's been a game changer even for my oily skin in the winter months. It leaves me feeling so hydrated when I use it in the nighttime and it makes my face feel so soft!

extraits.titre: So good for my sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This has been such a game changing serum. I struggle with redness due to sensitivity and eczema. This serum has very quickly calmed my skin, but also combated my dryness. I definitely think if you have very reactive skin like mine, you could see results from as little as a week of use. I received this complimentary from Murad but all thoughts and opinions are my own.

I received this complimentary from Murad. As the name suggests it is hydrating. I don't have any barrier damage my skin was dehydrated which caused it to look wrinkly with fine lines and like I had early aging. This with good moisturizers has hydrated my skin helping it to look plump and young again.
